description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the PatientDataVoidHandler class in the OpenMRS API module. It tests the voiding logic for patients, encounters, observations, orders, and cohort memberships within the OpenMRS healthcare system.

classes.name: PatientDataVoidHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for PatientDataVoidHandler, verifying the voiding of patient data and cohort memberships.

methods.name: handle_shouldVoidTheOrdersEncountersAndObservationsAssociatedWithThePatient
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly voids all encounters, observations, and orders associated with a patient.

methods.name: handle_shouldVoidCohortMemberships
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly voids cohort memberships for a patient, especially when they belong to multiple periods.
